main.title: Luigi's Mansion 3
main.subtitle: Luigi explores the Last Resort hotel
main.summary: Luigi?s Mansion 3 sends Luigi through the themed floors of a haunted hotel with the Poltergust G-00 and his gooey double, Gooigi.

cards.heading: A haunted hotel to explore
cards.text: Luigi?s Mansion 3 is Next Level Games? 2019 Switch adventure, released on October 31. Luigi explores the haunted Last Resort hotel with the Poltergust G-00 vacuum. Slam, Suction Shot and Burst provide new ways to catch ghosts and manipulate objects, while Gooigi helps reach otherwise inaccessible places.

cards.heading: A different theme on each floor
cards.text: Each floor has a different theme, including a medieval castle, greenhouses, a film studio and a pyramid. Recovered elevator buttons unlock further floors. The hotel gives the adventure a clear route while allowing each destination its own puzzles and boss.

cards.heading: The Poltergust G-00?s tools
cards.text: Luigi can slam a captured ghost into the floor, fire a suction cup to pull objects or strip protection, and use Burst to release a blast of air. These actions work in both combat and environmental puzzles. Furniture and loose objects react to the force of the vacuum.

cards.heading: Gooigi reaches other places
cards.text: Gooigi can pass through grates and reach spaces Luigi cannot. In single-player, one person switches between them; a second player can control Gooigi in local cooperation. Their different abilities let puzzles divide tasks between the two.
